Ercot Power Market Outlook 2026: A Balancing Act

Data Centers

Published on November 9, 2026

Executive summary

Data centers are pushing the Electric Reliability Council of Texas, or Ercot, into a period of extreme demand growth. New gas, renewable and storage capacity is expanding supply, but balances will ultimately be determined by how quickly large new loads can connect to the grid and how much demand is ultimately served by on-site generation.
